package.description: Automated LaTeX compilation tool written in Python, with multi-engine intelligent builds and automatic bibliography & index processing

en-US.description: Automated LaTeX compilation tool written in Python, with multi-engine intelligent builds and automatic bibliography & index processing
en-US.longDescription:
PyTeXMK (Python TeX Make) is an automated LaTeX compilation tool written in Python, inspired by latexmk. It intelligently determines the number of compilation passes based on auxiliary file changes, paired with colored terminal output and automatic scheduling of bibliography and index toolchains, enabling a streamlined one-click LaTeX compilation workflow.
Core features:
- Multi-engine compilation support: Full support for XeLaTeX, PdfLaTeX, and LuaLaTeX, flexibly switchable via command-line arguments or magic comments
- Intelligent multi-pass detection: Automatically compares .aux/.out auxiliary file contents and parses log rerun warnings to ensure stable convergence of cross-references, bookmarks, page counts and more
- Automatic bibliography processing: Supports automatic scheduling of multiple backends including bibtex and biblatex (biber)
- Index and glossary compilation: Supports glossaries, nomencl, makeidx and other formats, with automatic selection of xindy or makeindex backends
- Magic comment configuration: Specify compilation engine, main file, output directory, auxiliary directory and other parameters directly via comments in the TeX main file
- Smart cleaning: Multiple cleaning modes available, supporting precise cleanup of auxiliary files by directory scope and file extension
- Error log parsing: Automatically parses LaTeX logs upon compilation failure to accurately locate error positions
- LaTeX diff comparison: Compares two TeX source files and generates PDF documents with revision marks
- PDF repair and preview: Automatically repairs corrupted PDF files, and supports auto-preview with the default reader after compilation
- Multi-language interface: Default Chinese interface with full internationalization extensibility
- Two-level configuration system: Supports user-level and project-level TOML configuration files, with all compilation parameters fully customizable
- Multi-subproject management: Manage multiple independent LaTeX subprojects under a single root directory, with automatic scanning and batch compilation support
- Automatic version check: Built-in update detection to retrieve the latest version immediately
en-US.name: PyTeXMK

zh-CN.description: 基于 Python 的 LaTeX 自动化编译辅助工具
zh-CN.longDescription:
PyTeXMK（Python TeX Make）是一款由 Python 编写的 LaTeX 自动化编译工具，灵感来源于 latexmk。它能够根据辅助文件变化智能决定编译轮次，配合彩色终端输出、参考文献与索引工具链自动调度，让 LaTeX 编译工作流一键完成。

核心功能特性：
- 多编译引擎支持：覆盖 XeLaTeX、PdfLaTeX、LuaLaTeX，可通过命令行参数或魔法注释灵活切换
- 智能多次编译检测：自动比较 .aux/.out 辅助文件内容并解析日志重编译警告，确保交叉引用、书签、总页数等稳定收敛
- 参考文献自动处理：支持 bibtex / biblatex（biber）等多种后端自动调度
- 索引与术语表编译：支持 glossaries、nomencl、makeidx 等格式，自动选择 xindy 或 makeindex 后端
- 魔法注释配置：在 TeX 主文件内通过注释即可指定编译引擎、主文件、输出目录、辅助目录等参数
- 智能清理：提供多种清理模式，支持按目录范围和文件后缀精确清理辅助文件
- 错误日志解析：编译失败后自动解析 LaTeX 日志，精准定位错误位置
- LaTeX 差异对比：支持两个 TeX 文件对比，生成带修订标记的 PDF 文档
- PDF 修复与预览：自动修复损坏的 PDF 文件，编译完成后可调用默认阅读器自动预览
- 多语言界面：默认中文界面，支持国际化扩展
- 两级配置体系：支持用户级与项目级 TOML 配置文件，所有编译参数均可自定义
- 多子项目管理：单个根目录下可管理多个独立 LaTeX 子项目，支持自动扫描与批量编译
- 版本自动检查：内置更新检测，第一时间获取最新版本
